findings: Actual fresh arrivals preserve the classic shop/coast and Benicia pier composition.

All three scenes retain the current one-button fishing action, post-cast drag on the left, and no separate twitch action. Controls remain within the viewport and clear of the angler, rod and line entry.
Carolina rigs show no bobber. Deep fish remain hidden; the recorded fight frames reach the near-surface visibility threshold through actual simulation.
Benicia retains 20 public anglers. All observed tide calls during drawing receive the same shared epoch as the sea state.
No new composition, camera, control or tide-rendering regression observed after the surf cache fix.

observations.description: At less than ten metres, a small near-surface fish and the line endpoint can overlap the large authored angler silhouette around the hat. This existing art/physics projection limitation appears in the explicit near-fish fixtures.
Bright moving foam behind the unbacked location/instruction text can briefly reduce contrast. The backed clock and action controls stay legible.
